comments.author: fallenq
comments.body_html: Can you link renodx for tarkov?

comments.author: FlipFlop123
comments.body_html:
Sure, you can use the normal modlist and then choose unity: https://github.com/clshortfuse/renodx/wiki/Mods

Or you can use the automatic(you just need to add the SPT folder manually) tool which installs these things for you more easily: https://github.com/RankFTW/RenoDXChecker/releases

I also suggest to use these mods for even better quality graphics:

CloudSix - Volumetric Clouds https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2567/cloudsix-volumetric-clouds

AO Replacer https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2569/ao-replacer

Shadow Flicker Fix https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/1621/shadow-flicker-fix

I hope you enjoy!

P.S. I personally added 50 fake HDR, reduced highlights a little to 40(to keep the sky from blinding you) and upped the contrast a little to 60(to get real blacks), but your mileage might vary depending on your setup. If you have any questions, then I’ll gladly answer them.
